expl: Brass is an alloy made of copper (Cu) and zinc (Zn). Brass is used for making utensils, wires, machines, cartridges, etc. The properties of alloys are generally different from those of their constituent elements; for example, steel is stronger than its main constituent iron.

expl: In general, chromium and nickel are used to make stainless (rust-resistant) steel. By mixing these components with iron, stainless steel is prepared.

options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The gas released on opening a soda water bottle is carbon dioxide (CO), which remains dissolved in the soda under high pressure.

stem: Which of the following statements about graphite and diamond is true?

options.label: a
options.text: They have the same crystal structure.

options.label: c
options.text: They have the same electrical conductivity.

options.label: d
options.text: They can undergo a similar chemical reaction.

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Graphite and diamond are both allotropes of carbon, but their crystal structures are different. Diamond is naturally the hardest substance, whereas graphite is less hard. Graphite has higher electrical conductivity than diamond. Since both graphite and diamond are made of carbon atoms linked by covalent bonds, their chemical properties are similar and they can undergo the same chemical reactions.

stem: Dry ice is –
expl: Solid carbon dioxide looks like ice; therefore, it is called dry ice. Dry ice sublimates directly into carbon dioxide gas without changing into the liquid state.

stem: Which of the following does not consist of carbon?
expl: Diamond, graphite, and coal are all allotropes of carbon. Therefore, carbon is present in all three.

stem: Which is the hardest in the following?
expl: Diamond is the hardest natural substance. In diamond, each carbon atom is strongly bonded to other carbon atoms. As a result, it has a rigid three-dimensional structure. Due to its hardness, it is used for cutting glass and for making tools that drill holes in hard stones.

stem: To make the steel hard requires increase in –
expl: By adding suitable alloying elements to steel, the required hardness, ductility, and malleability are obtained. The more carbon is added to iron, the harder the steel becomes. However, as hardness increases, brittleness also increases. Manganese is used to increase tensile strength, while nickel is used to make it corrosion-resistant.

stem: Catalyst used in hydrogenation of vegetable oil into vanaspati ghee is

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/ More than one of the above

expl: To convert vegetable oil into vanaspati ghee, nickel (Ni) is used as a catalyst. The process of converting vegetable oil into ghee is called hydrogenation. In this process, hydrogen gas is mixed with vegetable oil. As a result, the unsaturated fatty acids present in vegetable oil react with hydrogen, and their double bonds are converted into single bonds. This increases the melting point of the oil, and it becomes semi-solid at room temperature.

stem: the gas used in the manufacture of Vanaspati Ghee from Vanaspati Oil is –

stem: Diamond is an allotrope (Form) of -
expl: Diamond is an allotrope of carbon. In diamond, each carbon atom bonds with four other atoms to form a strong three-dimensional tetrahedral structure.

stem: Which of the following statements about diamond and graphite is true?

options.label: c
options.text: They have same degree of hardness.

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: Diamond and graphite are both known as allotropes of carbon, but neither their crystal structure nor their hardness is the same. In diamond, carbon atoms form a three-dimensional tetrahedral structure, whereas in graphite they form planar hexagonal rings. Diamond is the hardest substance, while graphite is very soft. Similarly, diamond is a poor conductor of electricity, whereas graphite is an excellent conductor. Hence, option (e) is the correct answer.

stem: The purest form of the amorphous carbon is

options.label: e

expl: The purest form of amorphous carbon is lamp black.

stem: in the context of lab-grown diamonds (LGDs), what is used as a diamond seed?
expl: In the context of laboratory-grown diamonds (LGD), graphite is used as the diamond seed. These diamonds are mainly produced by two methods: the High Pressure–High Temperature (HPHT) method or Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD).

options.label: e

expl: Fullerene is an allotrope of carbon, which contains 60 carbon atoms. It is used in semiconductors, lubricants, etc.

stem: An element X has four electrons in its outermost orbit. What will be the formula of its compounds with hydrogen?
expl: An element having 4 electrons in the outermost shell will form four covalent bonds to attain stability. Hydrogen has one electron in its outermost shell and needs one more electron to become stable. Therefore, four hydrogen atoms will combine with the element having four valence electrons, forming XH.

stem: Which compound is used in contraceptive pills?
expl: Common oral contraceptive pills and emergency contraceptive pills are mainly based on a synthetic progestogen; the most commonly used compound is levonorgestrel.

stem: Water gas is a mixture of

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Water gas is a mixture of carbon monoxide and hydrogen gas (CO + H), whereas a mixture of carbon monoxide and nitrogen (CO + N) is called producer gas. The calorific value of water gas is about 2800 kcal/kg. It is used as a reducing agent in the manufacture of hydrogen and alcohol.

stem: Bromine is-

expl: Bromine is a dark reddish-brown, volatile liquid with a sharp smell. Bromine (Br) has atomic number 35 and remains in the liquid state at room temperature. It is non-flammable and slightly soluble in water. Bromine is a member of group 17, which is also known as the halogen group.

stem: Human skin burns during swimming in lake/ pond -
expl: Human skin burns during swimming in lake/pond because chlorine (Cl) is used for purification of lake water. Due to excess chlorine, the skin gets burnt.

stem: Hydrofluoric acid is not kept in a glass bottle because it reacts with
expl: Hydrofluoric acid is not kept in a glass. Hydrofluoric acid (HF) is a highly reactive compound. It reacts with the silicon dioxide of glass, due to which the bottle gets corroded.

stem: What is the shape of a sulfur hexafluoride molecule?

stem: Which is used as laughing gas –
expl: Nitrous oxide (NO) is “laughing gas”. It causes laughter when inhaled. Doctors also use it as an anesthetic.

expl: Kevlar fibre is used for the construction of lightweight bulletproof helmets and jackets. Kevlar is a strong, heat-resistant (thermal-resistant), and synthetic fiber.

expl: Acids react with metal carbonates to release carbon dioxide gas; along with this, metal salts and water are also formed. Sodium carbonate reacts with hydrochloric acid to form sodium chloride, carbon dioxide, and water.

stem: Why does dry hCl gas not change the color of dry litmus paper?

options.label: b

options.label: c
options.text: No HO+ ions are present. Litmus changes color only 3 in the presence of HO+ ions. 3

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: Litmus paper changes color only in the presence of ions such as hydrogen (H+) or hydronium (HO+). HCl can produce these ions only in aqueous solution. Therefore, dry HCl gas does not change the colour of dry litmus paper.

stem: Table salt (NaCl) is a product of –
